name: University of Cambridge
typicalOffer: A*A*A, Mathematics, Chemistry and a third science/mathematics subject (Biology, Physics or Further Mathematics)
courseName: Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology BA (Hons) and MEng
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: Imperial College London
typicalOffer: A*A*A, A* in Chemistry; A* in Mathematics; A in Biology, Business Studies, Economics, Further Mathematics or Physics
notes: Imperial is widely regarded as the UK's top standalone Chemical Engineering department. World-class research in reaction engineering, process systems and biochemical engineering. Major employers include BP, Shell, AstraZeneca and Procter & Gamble. Mathematics, Chemistry and Physics required.

name: University College London
notes: UCL Chemical Engineering has particular strengths in biochemical engineering, process intensification and energy systems. Strong London employer network — BP, Shell and Dow Chemical are active recruiters. Mathematics and Chemistry required.

name: University of Manchester
typicalOffer: AAA, including Mathematics and either Chemistry or Physics
notes: Manchester's Centre for Process Integration is internationally recognised. Strong links to ICI legacy and the UK chemical and petrochemical industries in the North West. Mathematics and Chemistry required at A-level.

name: University of Edinburgh
typicalOffer: AAA-ABB, Mathematics at B and Chemistry at B
notes: Edinburgh Chemical Engineering has strong oil and gas process engineering expertise (proximity to North Sea industry). 4-year Scottish BEng or 5-year MEng pathway. Mathematics and Chemistry required; Physics recommended.

name: University of Bath
notes: Bath Chemical Engineering consistently achieves excellent graduate employment through its mandatory placement year. Placement employers include AstraZeneca, Pfizer, Procter & Gamble, Kimberly-Clark and Unilever. Mathematics and Chemistry required.

name: University of Birmingham
typicalOffer: AAA, including Mathematics and Chemistry or Physics
notes: Birmingham Chemical Engineering has particular strengths in biochemical engineering, reaction engineering and sustainable process design. Proximity to the Midlands chemical industry corridor. Mathematics and Chemistry required.

name: University of Sheffield
typicalOffer: AAA, including Maths and a science or technology subject
notes: Sheffield Chemical Engineering is strong in particle technology, combustion and sustainable energy. Grantham Centre for Sustainable Futures links environmental sustainability to chemical process design. Mathematics and Chemistry required.

name: University of Leeds
typicalOffer: AAA, including Mathematics and either Physics or Chemistry; pass in practical science element required
notes: Leeds Chemical Engineering is internationally known for food engineering and particle technology. Institute of Process Research and Development (iPRD) bridges industrial chemistry and chemical engineering. Mathematics and Chemistry required.

name: University of Nottingham
typicalOffer: AAA, A in maths and A in either chemistry or physics
notes: Nottingham has proximity to AstraZeneca (major graduate employer) and is strong in pharmaceutical process engineering and bioprocess engineering. Mathematics and Chemistry required.

name: Newcastle University
typicalOffer: ABB, including Chemistry and Mathematics or Further Mathematics
notes: Newcastle Chemical Engineering has strong process engineering and energy systems groups. The North East's chemical industry (Teesside chemical cluster) provides excellent industry links. Mathematics and Chemistry required.

name: Loughborough University
typicalOffer: AAB, including Maths and at least one from Chemistry or Physics
notes: Loughborough Chemical Engineering is strong in bioprocessing, water treatment and sustainable energy. Excellent industry placement record with FMCG and energy companies. Mathematics and Chemistry required.
